nodes.label: Senior Backend Agent Skill
nodes.description: Comprehensive backend development skill covering NodeJS, Express, Go, Python, Postgres, GraphQL, REST APIs with API scaffolding, database optimization, security, and performance tuning.

nodes.label: Skill Creator Skill
nodes.description: Meta-skill for creating, evaluating, and iteratively improving Claude Code skills with quantitative benchmarks and human review loops.

nodes.label: Grader Agent
nodes.description: Subagent that evaluates expectations against execution transcripts and outputs, grades pass/fail with evidence, and critiques eval quality.

nodes.label: Blind Comparator Agent
nodes.description: Subagent that compares two outputs blind (without knowing which skill produced them) using a rubric-based scoring system to determine quality winner.

nodes.label: Post-hoc Analyzer Agent
nodes.description: Subagent that analyzes blind comparison results and benchmark data to extract actionable insights about why a winner won and how to improve the loser.

nodes.label: Skill Creator JSON Schemas
nodes.description: Defines JSON schemas for evals.json, grading.json, metrics.json, timing.json, benchmark.json, comparison.json, analysis.json, and history.json used in the skill evaluation pipeline.

nodes.label: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
nodes.description: Comprehensive UI/UX design intelligence skill with 50+ styles, 161 color palettes, 57 font pairings, 161 product types, 99 UX guidelines, and 25 chart types across 10 stacks.

nodes.label: Vue Expert JS Skill
nodes.description: Senior Vue specialist skill for building Vue 3 applications with JavaScript and JSDoc typing (no TypeScript). Covers components, composables, state management, and testing.

nodes.label: Vue Component Architecture Reference
nodes.description: Reference guide covering Vue 3 component patterns: props, emits, v-model, slots, provide/inject, and dynamic components with JSDoc annotations.

nodes.label: Vue Composables Patterns Reference
nodes.description: Reference for Vue 3 composable patterns: ref vs reactive, lifecycle hooks, shared singleton state, async with cancellation, and basic composable structure.

nodes.label: JSDoc Typing for Vue Reference
nodes.description: Reference for JSDoc-based type annotations in Vue 3: typing refs, computed, reactive, props, emits, composables, Pinia stores, and shared type definitions.

nodes.label: Vue State Management Reference
nodes.description: Reference for Pinia state management in Vue 3: options store syntax, setup store syntax (Composition API), store composition, persistence, and testing.

nodes.label: Vue Testing Patterns Reference
nodes.description: Reference for testing Vue 3 components with Vitest and Vue Test Utils: component testing, v-model testing, async testing, mocking composables, Pinia testing, and provide/inject testing.

nodes.label: Vue JSON Render Skill
nodes.description: Vue 3 renderer for json-render that converts JSON specs into Vue component trees with data binding, visibility, and actions. Uses @json-render/vue and @json-render/core.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md (Ponytail Lazy Senior Dev Mode)
nodes.description: Project coding philosophy document defining YAGNI-driven lazy senior developer approach: minimal code, reuse existing patterns, shortest working diff, root-cause bug fixing.

nodes.label: IDEA.md (Pooyesh Taxi Platform Requirements)
nodes.description: Requirements document for the Pooyesh Taxi (3V_Pooyesh) platform covering 4 portals (website, admin dashboard, passenger app, driver app), SSO, pricing algorithms, and tech stack.

nodes.label: API Design Patterns Reference
nodes.description: Reference guide for API design patterns and practices covering code organization, performance considerations, security best practices, and anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Backend Security Practices Reference
nodes.description: Reference guide for backend security covering input validation, authentication, authorization, data protection, and performance considerations.

nodes.label: Database Optimization Guide Reference
nodes.description: Reference guide for database optimization covering patterns, performance considerations, security best practices, and common anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Pooyesh Taxi Platform
nodes.description: Full taxi platform with website (Nuxt 3), admin dashboard (Nuxt 3), passenger app (React Native), driver app (React Native), backend (Node.js+Express+Prisma), PostgreSQL+Redis, Socket.io.

nodes.label: Ponytail Coding Philosophy
nodes.description: Lazy senior dev approach: YAGNI ladder, reuse before write, shortest working diff, root-cause bug fixing, no unnecessary abstractions, deletion over addition.

nodes.label: Skill Evaluation Benchmark System
nodes.description: Multi-stage evaluation pipeline for skills: spawn parallel runs (with/without skill), draft assertions, grade outputs, aggregate benchmarks, analyze results, and iterate.

nodes.label: Skill Description Optimization
nodes.description: Process to optimize skill triggering accuracy: generate trigger eval queries (should/should-not trigger), run optimization loop with train/test split, apply best_description.

nodes.label: JSDoc Type Safety System
nodes.description: Approach to type safety in Vue 3 without TypeScript: @typedef for object shapes, @param/@returns for functions, @type for reactive variables, shared type files with import() syntax.

nodes.label: JSON Render Vue System
nodes.description: Architecture for converting JSON specs into Vue component trees: defineCatalog, defineRegistry with h() render functions, StateProvider/ActionProvider/VisibilityProvider/ValidationProvider, composables for state/actions/visibility.

nodes.label: Taxi Pricing Algorithm
nodes.description: Dynamic pricing engine for intercity and intracity trips using base cost, distance rate, time rate, vehicle category coefficient, dynamic/weather coefficient, and surge pricing via Geohash.

nodes.label: Taxi Vehicle Categories
nodes.description: Vehicle categories: Eco Urban (Pride, Tiba, 206, Quick), Eco (Samand, Peugeot, Pars), Eco+ (Ario, Brilliance), VIP (Prius, Fluence, Accent), VIP+ (Sonata, Camry, Krowal), SUV VIP (Santa Fe, Rav4), Van C (Hiace, Hyundai H350).
